actions.name: create-row
actions.description: Creates a new row in the selected table.

actions.name: update-row
actions.description: Updates an existing row in the selected table.

actions.name: upsert-row
actions.description: Creates a new row or updates an existing one if it matches key columns.

actions.name: find-row
actions.description: Find specific rows in the selected table using a column match search.

actions.name: get-row
actions.description: Retrieves a single row by specified ID.

actions.name: list-tables
actions.description: List tables in a selected document.

actions.name: get-table
actions.description: Get the details of a specific table: name, type, row count, display column and layout.

actions.name: get_current_user
actions.description: Returns the Coda account and workspace that the connected API token belongs to.

actions.name: list_docs
actions.description: Lists the docs the connected account can open, one page at a time, with optional search and filters.

actions.name: get_doc
actions.description: Gets the details of a doc: name, owner, links, folder, workspace and size.

actions.name: create_doc
actions.description: Creates a new doc, either blank (optionally with a first page) or as a copy of an existing doc.

actions.name: delete_doc
actions.description: Permanently deletes a doc. This cannot be undone through the API.

actions.name: list_folders
actions.description: Lists the folders the connected account can see, one page at a time.

actions.name: list_pages
actions.description: Lists the pages of a doc, one page of results at a time.

actions.name: get_page
actions.description: Gets a page's details: name, subtitle, parent, subpages, visibility and links.

actions.name: get_page_content
actions.description: Exports a page's content as Markdown or HTML text.

actions.name: create_page
actions.description: Adds a new page to a doc, optionally under a parent page and with Markdown or HTML content.

actions.name: update_page
actions.description: Renames, hides or shows a page, and can append, prepend or replace its content.

actions.name: delete_page
actions.description: Deletes a page and everything on it, including its tables.

actions.name: list_columns
actions.description: Lists a table's columns with their IDs, names and types, one page at a time.

actions.name: list_rows
actions.description: Lists rows of a table one page at a time, optionally only rows where a column equals a value.

actions.name: create_rows
actions.description: Adds one or more rows to a table, each given as column → value.

actions.name: upsert_rows
actions.description: Updates rows whose key columns match, and adds the rest as new rows.

actions.name: delete_rows
actions.description: Permanently deletes rows from a table by row ID.

actions.name: push_button
actions.description: Presses a button in a table row, running whatever action the button is set up to do. If the button is disabled for that row, Coda accepts the press but nothing happens.

actions.name: list_formulas
actions.description: Lists the named formulas in a doc, one page at a time.

actions.name: get_formula
actions.description: Gets the current value of a named formula.

actions.name: list_controls
actions.description: Lists the controls (sliders, pickers, buttons…) in a doc, one page at a time.

actions.name: get_control
actions.description: Gets the type and current value of a control.

actions.name: get_mutation_status
actions.description: Checks whether an earlier change (by its Request ID) has been applied by Coda.

actions.name: list_permissions
actions.description: Lists who a doc is shared with and their access level, one page at a time.

actions.name: add_permission
actions.description: Shares a doc with a person (by email) or with everyone at an email domain.

actions.name: remove_permission
actions.description: Stops sharing a doc with a person or domain, by permission ID.

actions.name: trigger_automation
actions.description: Runs a doc automation whose trigger is "Webhook invoked", optionally passing a JSON payload.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new-row-created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new row is added to the selected table.
